title: OpenAI retires gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest on 1 December 2026: what to change
description: On 1 December 2026, OpenAI removes gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest from the API. The replacements, what else changes, how to find every use in your code, and how to test before you switch.
body_markdown:
On 1 December 2026, OpenAI removes gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest from the API, together with its dated version. From that day, API calls to these models fail. OpenAI's recommended replacement (as of 13 November 2026): gpt-image-2.6-sunburst or gpt-image-2.6-flare.

## What retires, and what replaces it

OpenAI lists these models on its [deprecations page](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations). The dates and replacements on this page come from Driftline's registry, which is checked against that page several times a day, so they stay current if OpenAI changes them.

| Model | Replacement | Moving to it |
|---|---|---|
| [`gpt-image-1-mini`](https://aidriftline.com/models/gpt-image-1-mini/) | `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` or `gpt-image-2.6-flare` | Rename |
| [`gpt-image-1.5`](https://aidriftline.com/models/gpt-image-1.5/) | `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` or `gpt-image-2.6-flare` | Rename |
| [`gpt-image-1.5-2025-12-16`](https://aidriftline.com/models/gpt-image-1.5-2025-12-16/) | `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` or `gpt-image-2.6-flare` | Rename |
| [`chatgpt-image-latest`](https://aidriftline.com/models/chatgpt-image-latest/) | `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` or `gpt-image-2.6-flare` | Rename |

## Find every place your code uses them

Run this in the root of your repository. No install, account or API key; it lists every OpenAI, Anthropic and Google model ID it finds, with file, line, retirement date and replacement:

```bash
npx -y @aidriftline/driftline .
```

A plain search works too:

```bash
grep -rnE '"(gpt-image-1-mini|gpt-image-1\.5|gpt-image-1\.5-2025-12-16|chatgpt-image-latest)"' .
```

It misses model names set outside the code: environment variables, deployment settings, values stored in a database, and defaults inside SDKs or agent frameworks you never configured.

## Test before 1 December 2026

Run a handful of real requests on the replacement and compare the results with what you get today, before the date. Check the parts your code depends on: output format, quality, length and timing.

## Get a reminder

The free [Driftline GitHub Action](https://aidriftline.com/#install) flags retired and soon-to-retire model IDs on every pull request, so the next retirement doesn't come as a surprise.

## Questions

### Will calls to gpt-image-1-mini keep working after 1 December 2026?

No. OpenAI removes the model from the API on that day, and requests to it return an error.
